educationalGoal: Psychology is a field that seeks to scientifically understand the “mind” behind behavior at various levels, from the personal to the social. The objectives of this course are: (1) to understand the behavior of oneself and others from a psychological perspective and to cultivate insight into human beings, and (2) to link this to personal growth based on the knowledge and skills gained in lectures and discussions on the human mind.
advice: This course will cover the following topics in psychology. Topics History of psychology, mind and brain, sensation and perception, motivation, mental training, memory, personality, development, society and groups, relationships, stress management, clinical, disorders Basic concepts, terminology, and theories will be explained for these topics. Through exercises and group discussions, students will deepen their understanding of the content of these topics, leading to greater self-understanding and understanding of others.
books: Required Materials (textbooks, reference books, reserved books). Textbooks:心理学概論[株式会社サイエンス社]
requiredKnowledge: ・It is recommended that students read the textbook in advance and have some prior knowledge of the subject. ・In class, students are expected to prepare PowerPoint presentations, give presentations, and engage in group discussions. ・An attitude of seeking to deepen self-understanding and understanding of others through classes and an attitude of seeking to improve skills are desirable.
